text:
Mia Chen: Quick design review of the stacked-area widget on dashboard B — zero baseline basically disappears on the dark theme. screenshot: https://redwood.mock/snap/03.png
Samir Patel: Yep saw that. Proposal: make zero-line 2px solid #E6EEF3 (muted ink) and reduce area min-opacity to 0.16 so small values don't read as noise.
Ashley Rivera: 2px sounds safer for a11y and hi-dpi. Also can we consider a subtle hairline at 0 and a heavier faint shadow under it? Keyboard focus state for the series legend needs to show when zero-line toggle is used.
Samir Patel: Nice. +1 for keyboard focus. For config API I was thinking:
```
chart.zeroLine = { weight: 2, style: 'solid', color: '--muted-ink' }
chart.area = { minOpacity: 0.16 }
```
Mia Chen: @Samir Patel, can we expose a chart-level toggle: `Axis granularity: Auto | Fixed`? Designers want fixed steps for finance charts, auto for telemetry.
Samir Patel: Yep. Implementation note: auto should compute step by niceNumber(range / targetTicks). Fixed should accept an array of tick values.
Ashley Rivera: Outlier handling: current clamp-to-max hides spikes (product asked). Suggest showing clipped markers instead of dropping points. Like draw marker at top with a caret ▲ and tooltip "> 120k".
Samir Patel: Or keep markers but apply slight x-jitter to avoid overlap and fade them to alpha 0.6. For percentiles > 99.9 show a bold orange marker.
Mia Chen: Love the marker + caret fallback. Pseudocode:
```
if (y > yMax) { drawCaret(x, yTop); label = `>${yMaxFormatted}` }
else { drawDot(x + jitter(), y) }
```
Jordan (design-bot): accessibility-check: zero-line color (#E6EEF3) vs bg (#0F1720) => contrast 3.1:1. WCAG AA requires 3:1 for 18pt+ (pass) but 4.5:1 for normal text (n/a). Flagging keyboard focus for legend toggles.
Ashley Rivera: Also small copy tweak: change legend tooltip from "Clamp" to "Clipped (visible)" — clearer for non-technical folks.
Mia Chen: I'll update Figma with the zero-line + caret examples and the toggle variants. Will add notes for @frontend to implement jitter+fade. ETA: EOD today. :sparkles:
Jordan (design-bot): Figma file updated: https://figma.com/file/abc123/stacked-area-zero-line
Samir Patel: Thanks — will prototype the CSS vars and a small unit test for tick generation.
Ashley Rivera: :thumbsup: Thanks team — feel free to leave quick comments on the Figma frames.
